prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic multi-view modeling reference for a Korean apartment corridor prop. All four views must show the same object and proportions. Neutral studio illumination, moderate satin sheen, tiny realistic handling marks, intact maintained hardware. No dramatic rust, fantasy geometry, extra knobs, cables, illustration, text annotations or measurements around the product.
